name: Song Pause
overview: See which song is playing when you pause a movie or TV episode.
description: Shows songs from a .songs.json timeline in Jellyfin Web and sends pause notifications to compatible native clients.

versions.changelog: Raise the song card below the player toolbar. Fit its width to the text, with a maximum of 250 percent of the approved narrow card width and wrapping beyond that limit.
Move the song card to the top right, with separate title and artist lines.
Support the native MPV player in Jellyfin Media Player: pause, paused seeking, resume, stop and player switching.
Install from the Jellyfin catalog. Automatically load the pause overlay in Jellyfin Web.
